description: This Java class 'GaugesGridElement' manages a UI component that can display either a sensor gauge or a live sensor graph. It provides methods to create these components, switch between modes, and maintain configuration state via a Node object.

classes.name: GaugesGridElement
classes.description: A UI component class for displaying either sensor gauges or live sensor graphs, with switching capabilities.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Static method to create and return the UI component (gauge or live graph) based on the configuration properties.

methods.name: createLiveBarElement
methods.description: Creates UI components for displaying live sensor graphs with switching to gauge mode.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge UI component for a specific sensor with mode switching to live graph.
